headword: {地下駐車場|ちかちゅうしゃじょう}
reading: ちかちゅうしゃじょう

definitions.gloss: underground parking lot; underground parking garage
definitions.explanation: A parking facility located below ground level. Common in urban areas of Japan where surface space is limited.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}は{地下駐車場|ちかちゅうしゃじょう}に{停|と}めた。
examples.english: I parked the car in the underground parking lot.

examples.japanese: このビルの{地下駐車場|ちかちゅうしゃじょう}は{二十四時間|にじゅうよじかん}{利用|りよう}{可能|かのう}です。
examples.english: This building's underground parking lot is available 24 hours.

examples.japanese: {地下駐車場|ちかちゅうしゃじょう}へはエレベーターで{降|お}りることができます。
examples.english: You can take the elevator down to the underground parking lot.

notes:
USAGE:
A straightforward compound of {地下|ちか} (underground) and {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (parking lot). Common in department stores, hotels, and commercial buildings in Japanese cities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地下駐車場|ちかちゅうしゃじょう}に{停|と}める (to park in the underground lot)
- {地下駐車場|ちかちゅうしゃじょう}の{入口|いりぐち} (entrance to the underground lot)

RELATED WORDS:
- {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: parking lot (general)
- {立体駐車場|りったいちゅうしゃじょう}: multi-story parking garage
